pages.text: Hives running the same aura amplify each other when clustered within about 12 blocks: each nearby hive running that aura adds to the pulse area, up to four neighbours' worth of bonus.

This rewards building a themed bee-yard - a whole row of Draconic hives side by side - over scattering your apiaries at random. Mix your tiers and you lose the bonus; commit to one aura per cluster and it grows with you.
